facts.name: Mark Wilson
facts.assignment: Profile: half of felony/misdemeanor criminal cases in lower Keys; has served as acting circuit judge for civil and criminal matters. Past acting civil service not treated as current civil allocation.

contact.contact_note: Office line; no separately identified assistant-only phone or personal judge email.

scheduling.summary: File motion first, then email JA with case/name, motion and time needed, copying parties. Coordinate offered dates without copying JA on counsel-only messages; await JA confirmation, then file notice.

communications.summary: Contact JA for procedural/scheduling matters; no substantive ex parte communications or informal requests substituting for filed motions.

remote_appearance.summary: Advance court permission required; request states whether other parties consent. Criminal pretrial appearances require a hearing-specific request and written approval; detailed criminal deadlines intentionally not summarized.
